DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{budgetDurationHours} HOUR)

INSERT IGNORE INTO mcp_virtual_key (api_key_hash, key_name, owner_user_id, status, expires_at, rpm_limit) VALUES (#{po.apiKeyHash}, #{po.keyName}, #{po.ownerUserId}, #{po.status}, #{po.expiresAt}, #{po.rpmLimit})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET key_name = #{keyName}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, rpm_limit = #{rpmLimit}, daily_request_limit = #{dailyRequestLimit}, daily_tool_call_limit = #{dailyToolCallLimit}, tpm_limit = #{tpmLimit}, daily_cost_limit = #{dailyCostLimit}, ip_allow_list = #{ipAllowList}, budget_soft = #{budgetSoft}, budget_hard = #{budgetHard}, budget_duration_hours = #{budgetDurationHours}, budget_reset_at = CASE WHEN #{budgetHard} IS NULL OR #{budgetDurationHours} IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN #{budgetResetAt} IS NULL THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{budgetDurationHours} HOUR) ELSE budget_reset_at END, budget_used = CASE WHEN #{budgetHard} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE budget_used END, cost_soft_limit = #{costSoftLimit}, cost_hard_limit = #{costHardLimit}, skip_guardrail_allowed = #{skipGuardrailAllowed}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET last_active_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET budget_used = 0, budget_reset_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL budget_duration_hours HOUR) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET budget_used = budget_used + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET temp_budget_hard = GREATEST(COALESCE(temp_budget_hard, budget_hard, 0), COALESCE(budget_hard, 0)) + #{increase}, temp_budget_expires = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE mcp_virtual_key SET prev_key_hash = api_key_hash, api_key_hash = #{newKeyHash}, grace_until = #{graceUntil}, rotation_count = rotation_count + 1, last_rotation_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_virtual_key WHERE api_key_hash = #{apiKeyHash} OR (prev_key_hash = #{apiKeyHash} AND grace_until IS NOT NULL AND grace_until > NOW()) LIMIT 1
